reviewer.method: Incremental primary-source correspondence audit; template and inventory preparation are not reading credit. Coverage and packet assessments are saved only as actually reviewed.

audit.exposure_note: Before source review on 2026-10-24, mandatory HANDOFF.md exposed aggregate public-validation outcomes (including top1/5/10 totals and corrected case/gene-macro deltas), source-audit aggregate coverage and the historical GIAB HG002 FGFR2 rank 1 at 0.9654.
